operators.name: abs_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise absolute value of input tensor x.
Input tensor is on CUDA, float32, contiguous with shape [512, 1024, 1024].
Output tensor has same shape, dtype, device, and layout as input.

operators.name: unsqueeze_forward
semantics: Adds a new dimension of size 1 at the specified dim (0 <= dim <= input.dim()).
Input tensor is on CUDA, float32, contiguous with shape [512, 1024, 1024] and dim=1.
Output tensor has shape [512, 1, 1024, 1024] and is contiguous.

Output tensor has same shape and dtype
